sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG("compliancecase"."prevviol") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("compliancecase"."modelconf" - "compliancecase"."risksc") AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."risksc")) AS m2 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref"  GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: compliancecase.relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score
why: average of previous violations per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
(model confidence - compliance risk score) / compliance risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
gap to the g average of average of relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score (g level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" AS e, AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."shortintrt") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("sentimentandfundamentals"."putcallrt" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."optvolrt") AS REAL) / "sentimentandfundamentals"."optvolrt")) AS m2 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" GROUP BY "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: sentimentandfundamentals.relative difference of put-to-call volume ratio from option volume vs average
why: average of short interest days to cover per transactionrecord (by transref)
(put-to-call volume ratio - option volume vs average) / option volume vs average: the relative difference of two quantities in ratio
average of relative difference of put-to-call volume ratio from option volume vs average per transactionrecord (by transref)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of put-to-call volume ratio from option volume vs average (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."trdref" AS e, "trader"."tradekind" AS g, AVG(("transactionrecord"."cancelpct" - "transactionrecord"."crossfreq")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("transactionrecord"."offmkt" - "transactionrecord"."darkusage") AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."darkusage")) AS m2 FROM "transactionrecord" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref"  GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."trdref", "trader"."tradekind"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: transactionrecord.order cancellation share minus cross trade share
transactionrecord.relative difference of off-exchange trade share from dark pool usage share
why: order cancellation share - cross trade share: both in fraction and of the same kind (stocks) on the same trade-day record per trader
average of order cancellation share minus cross trade share per trader within trader.tradekind
(off-exchange trade share - dark pool usage share) / dark pool usage share: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of off-exchange trade share from dark pool usage share per trader within trader.tradekind
gap to the g average of average of relative difference of off-exchange trade share from dark pool usage share (g level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."trdref" AS e, AVG("transactionrecord"."modfreq") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("transactionrecord"."crossfreq" - "transactionrecord"."offmkt") AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."offmkt")) AS m2 FROM "transactionrecord" GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."trdref"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: transactionrecord.relative difference of cross trade share from off-exchange trade share
why: average of modifications per order per trader (by trdref)
(cross trade share - off-exchange trade share) / off-exchange trade share: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of cross trade share from off-exchange trade share per trader (by trdref)
index against the all average of average of relative difference of cross trade share from off-exchange trade share (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, AVG((CAST(("compliancecase"."risksc" - "compliancecase"."modelconf") AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."modelconf")) AS m1 FROM "compliancecase" GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: compliancecase.relative difference of compliance risk score from model confidence
why: (compliance risk score - model confidence) / model confidence: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of compliance risk score from model confidence per transactionrecord (by transref)
index against the all average of average of relative difference of compliance risk score from model confidence (all level)
